THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Oඋൽൾඋ ඎඇൽൾඋ Sൾർඍංඈඇ 39A (1)

THE allotments speciﬁ ed in the Order No. 95 of 2014 made under the Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) and published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1861/6 dated 05th May, 2014 are vested absolutely in the State and the possession of which has been taken for or on behalf of the State under Paragraph (a) of Section 40 of the aforesaid Act. But by the virtue of powers vested in me by Sub section (1) of Section 39 (a) (inserted by Act, No. 8 of 1979) of the Land Acquisition Act, I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby divest only the allotment described in the Schedule 1 below.
